summary: The guest is a YouTuber whose long-term partner is herself one of Thailand's biggest creators, and she left the top comment by a wide margin — joking that any girl he flirts with only needs to be good at rock-paper-scissors, then praising all three hosts and asking them to upload more often. That single comment reframes the whole thread: much of the discussion is about his visible loyalty to her, read as touching rather than disappointing, with commenters citing his word choice, gaze and the moment he picks her by name. The elimination mechanic — he has to reject the hosts — provides the episode's narrative beat and gets its own amusement cluster. Guest requests are specific and completionist: viewers want the rest of his friend group booked so the set is complete.

audience_signals: Booking a creator whose partner is also a major creator doubles the reach — her comment is the most-liked in the thread by a factor of two and she publicly asks the channel to upload more
A guest visibly loyal to his real partner plays as wholesome and does not blunt the flirt format; the tension resolves rather than disappoints
The elimination mechanic gives every episode a guaranteed narrative beat independent of guest chemistry — worth protecting in the format
Fandom completionism is a booking lever: landing one member of a friend group creates named demand for all the others
Upload frequency is being asked for by peers as well as fans, so cadence is a visible constraint on this series
content_requests: Book Sung Satawin and Arm Weerayut to complete the friend group
